title: U.S. Men's Soccer Team Advances to Round of 16 with 2-0 Win Over Bosnia-Herzegovina
text:
the United States mens national soccer team secured a tricky-fought 2-0 victory over Bosnia-Herzegovina in the round of 32 at the World Cup, thanks to a dominant first-half performance from striker Haji Wright and a late goal from Malik Tillman. The triumph, achieved desPite playing with a man down for over 25 minutes, was the U.S.'s second Planet Cup knockout round triumph and propelled the team into the round of 16. The team will now face Belgium on Monday in Seattle.
The United States men's national soccer team secured a significant victory on Wednesday night, defeating Bosnia-Herzegovina 2-0 in the round of 32 at the World Cup .
The win, achieved despite playing with a man down for over 25 minutes, propelled the Americans into the round of 16. The match was marked by a dominant first-half performance from striker Haji Wright, who scored the opening goal in the 45th minute after a previous effort was disallowed for offside. The turning point arrived in the 64th minute when defender Walker Zimmerman was sent off for a foul,reducing the U.S. to 10 men.
Though, the team displayed remarkable resilience, with Malik Tillman converting a free kick in the 82nd minute to seal the win. The goal was the first World Cup goal from a free kick for the U.S. since 1994 and was awarded after a VAR review for a foul by Wright on Tarik Muharemovic. The U.S. coach, Mauricio Pochettino, praised his squad's character,stating, 'We had to dig deep for that one.
It did not go exactly to plan with the red card, but that just shows what a great squad we are.
' This victory is the U.S.'s second World Cup knockout round win,with their previous win coming against Mexico in 2002. The squad will at present face Belgium in the round of 16 on Monday in Seattle.
Wright, who leads the U.S. with three goals, will miss the Belgium match due to an automatic suspension for the red card. tillman, who scored the winning goAl, expressed confidence in his team's ability to replace Wright,stating, 'We have great players who can replace him, and give the best they can and hopefully score some nice goals as well.
' The game was played at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara,California, less than 20 miles from the site of the first U.S. knockout round game of the modern era in 1994. The U.S. was favored to prevail this match for the first time on record in a knockout round match and lived up to expectations,snapping a 10-game losing streak against European teams that dated back to a tie against England in the 2022 World Cup
